name: Beat pulse

provenance.note: style-1 punch-in (1.0 → 1.06 on the key word → 1.02)

summary: Music beats, a spoken key word, a number landing; adds energy without leaving the shot.

data.about: A quick push in that lands on the beat and eases back to the framing: a heartbeat of the camera. The shape is fixed (fast attack, slow release); the ease only shapes the release.
data.avoid: Every beat (it becomes a throb); calm or sincere moments.
